about: Payloads for schema v1 of POST /proxy/feedback, shared byte for byte by elffuss-home (tests/feedback-payload.mjs, validatePayload in site-chat/chat/feedback-payload.js) and by elffuss-claw and elffuss-code (tests/test_feedback.py, server/serve.py); each of those tests pins this file's sha256. Every 'valid' payload must be accepted. Every 'invalid' payload must be refused; 'expect' is what the server answers: 'schema' (400), 'bad-json' (400, not a JSON object) or 'leftover' (422, the safety net of anonymize.js, tests/fixtures/leftover-patterns.json). Names starting with 'example-' are a second case of the same kind, built on the spec's example. A slash before Users or home is written as \/ so the publication sweep stays clean.
